_comment: PhantomNet Sprint Config — Week 22 (Month 6 Week 2: Comprehensive Testing, Days 46-50)
milestone_description: Advanced features, CVE mapping, audit logging, system hardening, comprehensive E2E testing, and final V3.0 production delivery.

tasks.Title: Full Pytest Suite Execution and Failure Resolution
tasks.Objective: Run the full pytest suite for the entire PhantomNet V3 Sentinel Layer and fix any test failures.
Tasks: Execute the complete pytest suite including all backend and Sentinel modules.
Identify any failing unit or integration tests.
Fix the root causes of failures to ensure 100% test pass rate.
Deliverables: Test execution report with all passing tests.
Bug fixes for any failed tests.

tasks.Title: Playbook Generation Stress Test and DB Integrity
tasks.Objective: Stress test the Sentinel backend with 100 concurrent playbook generations to verify performance and database integrity.
Tasks: Write a load-testing script to trigger 100 concurrent generation requests.
Monitor database for locking issues or data corruption.
Validate that all 100 playbooks are accurately created and stored.
Deliverables: Stress test performance and DB integrity report.

tasks.Title: LLM Attack Pattern Coverage and Quality Assessment
tasks.Objective: Test LLM narrative generation with all 12 supported attack patterns and document output quality.
Tasks: Trigger playbook generation using the LLM integration for each of the 12 attack patterns.
Review the generated AI narratives for context accuracy, hallucinations, and formatting.
Document output quality and identify any prompt adjustments needed.
Deliverables: LLM quality assessment document for 12 attack patterns.

tasks.Title: Full UI Functional E2E Test
tasks.Objective: Perform a comprehensive manual functional test of every button, link, filter, and export feature in the UI.
Tasks: Click and verify all navigation links.
Test all playbook actions (Approve, Reject, Export, Compare, AI toggle).
Validate search, filtering, batch operations, and pagination.
Deliverables: UI E2E testing checklist and bug report.

tasks.Title: Comprehensive API Security Audit
tasks.Objective: Audit all backend API endpoints for proper authentication, input validation, and error handling.
Tasks: Verify auth requirements on sensitive endpoints.
Check input validation and sanitization for all payload fields.
Ensure error responses do not leak sensitive backend information.
Deliverables: API security audit report and applied fixes.

tasks.Title: TAXII Feed Pagination and Performance Verification
tasks.Objective: Test the TAXII feed server with 500+ STIX objects to verify pagination logic and response performance.
Tasks: Seed the database with 500+ STIX bundle records.
Query the TAXII feed and verify accurate pagination behavior.
Measure response times and optimize queries if necessary.
Deliverables: TAXII pagination test report and performance metrics.

tasks.Title: Real Honeypot Data Sentinel Pipeline E2E
tasks.Objective: Test the full Sentinel pipeline using live honeypot data and simulated attacks.
Tasks: Start honeypot services and run simulated attacks (e.g., nmap, hydra).
Verify packets are logged, ML scores them, and Sentinel generates the playbook.
Validate the end-to-end flow matches expected SOC analyst scenarios.

tasks.Title: Graceful Empty State UI Verification
tasks.Objective: Test the dashboard and all views with an empty database to verify graceful empty states.
Tasks: Clear the database of all playbooks, rules, and campaigns.
Navigate all pages to ensure no crashes or undefined errors occur.
Verify user-friendly 'No data available' messages are displayed.
Deliverables: Empty state UI verification report and applied fixes.

tasks.Title: P0 and P1 Bug Resolution (Core/API)
tasks.Objective: Fix all critical (P0) and high (P1) priority bugs identified during Day 1-2 testing in Core and API layers.
Tasks: Triage and resolve P0/P1 issues assigned to Team Lead.
Ensure fixes do not introduce regressions.
Merge fixes to main branch.

tasks.Title: P0 and P1 Bug Resolution (Security/TAXII)
tasks.Objective: Fix all critical (P0) and high (P1) priority bugs identified during Day 1-2 testing in Security and TAXII layers.
Tasks: Triage and resolve P0/P1 issues assigned to Security Developer.
Ensure fixes do not introduce regressions.
Merge fixes to main branch.

tasks.Title: P0 and P1 Bug Resolution (ML/LLM)
tasks.Objective: Fix all critical (P0) and high (P1) priority bugs identified during Day 1-2 testing in ML and LLM integration layers.
Tasks: Triage and resolve P0/P1 issues assigned to AI/ML Developer.
Ensure fixes do not introduce regressions.
Merge fixes to main branch.

tasks.Title: P0 and P1 Bug Resolution (Frontend/UI)
tasks.Objective: Fix all critical (P0) and high (P1) priority bugs identified during Day 1-2 testing in Frontend and UI components.
Tasks: Triage and resolve P0/P1 issues assigned to Frontend Developer.
Ensure fixes do not introduce regressions.
Merge fixes to main branch.

tasks.Title: Full Post-Fix Regression Test
tasks.Objective: Run a full regression test after all bug fixes to ensure core system functionality remains intact.
Tasks: Run the complete test suite again.
Perform manual spot-checks on core workflows.
Confirm no new issues were introduced by bug fixes.

tasks.Title: Clean Docker Build and Deployment Verification
tasks.Objective: Verify that the full application stack builds and runs cleanly from a fresh Docker compose environment.
Tasks: Run docker-compose build --no-cache.
Run docker-compose up and ensure all containers start without errors.
Verify API and Frontend are accessible and communicating.

tasks.Title: LLM Graceful Degradation Verification
tasks.Objective: Verify that the entire playbook generation system works flawlessly using templates when Ollama is offline or not installed.
Tasks: Stop the Ollama service locally.
Trigger playbook generation and ensure it falls back to Jinja2 templates without crashing.
Verify the UI correctly reflects the 'AI Offline' state.

tasks.Title: Final Visual QA and Documentation Screenshots
tasks.Objective: Perform a final visual QA pass on the UI and capture high-quality screenshots for documentation and the README.
Tasks: Check alignment, typography, and colors across all pages.
Capture screenshots of the Dashboard, Playbook Viewer, Mitre Matrix, and Export options.
Organize screenshots in the docs/images directory.

tasks.Title: Release Candidate 1 Final Sign-off (Team Lead)
tasks.Objective: Final sign-off on testing, ensure all P0/P1 bugs are resolved, and tag Release Candidate 1.
Tasks: Review overall testing and bug resolution status.
Ensure any remaining P2 bugs are documented as acceptable.
Tag the repository with v3.0.0-rc1.

tasks.Title: Release Candidate 1 Final Sign-off (Security)
tasks.Objective: Final sign-off on security testing, TAXII, and IDS rule generation for Release Candidate 1.
Tasks: Review security testing results.
Ensure all security-related P0/P1 bugs are fixed.
Provide sign-off for RC1.

tasks.Title: Release Candidate 1 Final Sign-off (AI/ML)
tasks.Objective: Final sign-off on ML models, LLM integration, and timeline APIs for Release Candidate 1.
Tasks: Review LLM and ML testing results.
Ensure all AI/ML-related P0/P1 bugs are fixed.
Provide sign-off for RC1.

tasks.Title: Release Candidate 1 Final Sign-off (Frontend)
tasks.Objective: Final sign-off on the React frontend, UI functionality, and themes for Release Candidate 1.
Tasks: Review frontend E2E and visual testing results.
Ensure all UI-related P0/P1 bugs are fixed.
Provide sign-off for RC1.
